verdict.rationale: Steel is a browser API for AI agents, so caching resolved actions or generated code for deterministic replay is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows only adjacent features: session recordings and replays, agent-trace exports, and reusing auth context across sessions. Viewing recordings, exporting traces, and skipping logins are not caching resolved actions so later runs replay without re-prompting the LLM, and nothing documents that capability.
